##### Project general facts

Alba Tower by Reportage Properties is an exclusive residential mid-rise tower bringing the whole city's luxury to your doorstep. With its meticulous Italian design and captivating interiors, this development offers an extraordinary living experience and a seamless blend of style and convenience. Featuring a collection of one and two-bedroom apartments, Alba Tower redefines urban living, providing a haven of comfort, sophistication, and tranquillity in the heart of the city.

Residents enjoy a lifestyle where life is made easier and luxury is within reach. The development features a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, retail areas, and dedicated play areas for children. Every detail is well-thought-of, reflecting a commitment to quality and opulence that meets all refined tastes. Alba Tower offers a life of distinction where residents are offered the opportunity to live their best lives.

Every residence at Alba Tower features modern Italian designs that speak of luxury and functionality, with every detail well-thought-of. The interiors are crafted with quality and opulence, creating a home of coziness with a touch of luxury in every bit of detail. The captivating interiors and meticulous design offer a seamless blend of style and convenience, making each home a sanctuary of comfort and sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Al Satwa, one of the prime destinations of the vibrant city of Dubai, this exceptional location is strategically positioned in the very heart of the city. With direct access to the main roads, bordered by Sheikh Zayed Road from the south and Jumeirah 1 from the north, the area places all of Dubai's attractions within reach.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to key destinations. Dubai World Trade Center, Dubai Frame, Museum of The Future, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Jumeirah Grand Mosque, Jumeirah Beach, and Dubai Metro are all within easy reach. The whole city life is at residents' fingertips, offering unparalleled convenience and connectivity.

For those seeking a residence that embodies contemporary elegance, urban sophistication, and a prime Dubai address, Al Satwa delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can embrace a life of distinction — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
